svg.text: Lathe: face and turn to 48 mm outside, 75 mm long.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Back end: bore 40.2 mm, 12 mm deep, for the collar spigot.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Offset the work 6.5 mm (4-jaw chuck): bore 29.3 mm from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 12 mm right through the front, for the base link of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: steerable tip. Thinnest wall 2.85 mm, at the bottom.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mill or saw and file on top: pocket 11.5 mm wide, floor

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 12 mm above the axis, 50 mm back from the front face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Groove on top 4.5 mm wide, floor 20 mm above the axis,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the back face to the pocket (breaks into the bore).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Three 4.5 mm holes 6 mm from the back face, at 30, 150

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and 270 deg from the side; countersink for M4.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two M3 tapped holes, 7 mm from the front, either side on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the bore's centre height, for the base link grub screws.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Break edges 0.5 mm. Check: base link spigot slides in.
